segmentation.text: It is unlawful for any person to drive or operate
a vehicle of any kind or character
a rate of speed greater than 80 miles per hour.

elements.justification: "drive or operate" is read through the vehicle's controlled motion: kin.speed, "magnitude of velocity"; the same words map to kin.speed in the run's index.

"a vehicle of any kind or character": the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle, "every device in, upon or by which any person or property is or may be transported or drawn upon a highway", whatever its class.
The rate of speed is kin.speed, "magnitude of velocity" (m/s), compared strictly greater than the literal 80 mph.

residues.why: "In any event" states that the bound holds whatever other limit or circumstance applies; it adds no condition, and the duty is the same whether or not the words are read.

obligation: kin.speed(subject) is not greater than the literal 80 mph.

narrowings.why: "drive or operate" is read through the vehicle's controlled motion, whoever or whatever controls it.
